scope: Additions and replacements after the original v2 review set (Oct 2026), approved by Peter in conversation. Same entry shape as source-manifest.json. A replacement takes the place of the original entry for the same family and tier; the original master stays on disk and in source-manifest.json as provenance. §power (Oct 14 2026): the Power Plant family, Solar Array I–II and Fusion Plant III–VI, plus `orbitals`: the floating plant drawn on belts and gas giants, one look per tier range.

buildings.name: Power Plant
buildings.identity: The planet's power station. Tiers I–II are Solar Arrays: tilted rows of dark blue-grey photovoltaic panels on steel stands, an inverter house and a fenced transformer yard. Tiers III–VI are Fusion Plants: a domed or toroidal reactor hall ringed by field-coil housings, radiator fins and a transformer yard; Deuterium tanks at III–IV, frosted cryogenic Helium-3 tanks at V–VI.
buildings.description: a small solar array: three short rows of tilted photovoltaic panels on steel stands, a small inverter house and a small transformer yard
